name: Micronaut Core 5.2.3
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Python-native streaming: async for over publishers, async generators as publishers by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13208
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Fix NPE in PythonContextRuntime.helper when contexts start concurrently by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13200
* Python: do not generate the is-getter of a boolean @property twice by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13205
* Survive a missing netty in LeakTracker.Factory.staticInitializer by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13191
* Subtract handed-off bytes from the shared buffer size count by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13106
* Python: constructor-injected async beans and awaited Python beans in event-loop contexts by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13206
* Python: merge source and Java package initializers, report duplicate types and skipped sources by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13204
* Python: bridge same-arity Java overloads, map *args to varargs, select Collection/byte[] overloads for list/bytes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13207
* Python: bridge overrides of inherited Java methods with the inherited signature by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13209
* Python: generate valid stubs for generic Java signatures by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13211
* Python: only treat @Bean-stereotyped methods of a @Factory as factory methods by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13215
* Python: compile introduction types with only abstract methods to Java interfaces by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13216
* Python: report the implicit constructor as primary constructor and derive element modifiers by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13217
* Python: load the runtime module once under the import lock by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13218
* Python: bytes type arguments as byte[] and reactive return type adaptation by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13219
* Python: resolve nested Java types as decorators, Annotated metadata and imports by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13220
* Python: forward super constructor arguments and messages of Python exception subclasses to the Java base by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13221
* Python: no-arg constructor for all-default dataclasses, untyped class attributes and constants in decorator members by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13223
* Python: propagate the Reactor context into publishers and coroutines returned by Python code by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13224
* Python: decide decorator forms and placeholder bodies from the source by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13225
* Python: expose Java interface default methods on Python implementations by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13227
* Python: bind imported Java classes to the host class at run time by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13230
* Python: nested application contexts keep the enclosing runtime, generated classes are persistable by EclipseStore by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13231
* Python: scoped proxies, nested member types and JVM-wide services of generated classes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13232
* Python: map keys, nullable bytes, subclass wrappers, missing and star imports, nested constants by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13234
* Python: visitor and annotation mapper integration fixes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13241
* Give ConcurrentFormTransferSpec.uploadTest a timeout that only catches a hang by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13185
* Keep draining a request body the server has already rejected by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13255
* Charge the declared Content-Length once on the HTTP/2 request path by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13256
### Improvements ⭐
* Keep buffered body pieces in place, size the JSON output buffer and parse the form type once by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13129
* HTTP server TCK: body framing, request size limit, cookie attributes, Content-Length; Vary is only CORS when it names Origin by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13147
* Resolve Java packages under io.* other than io.micronaut by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13238
* Python: initialize the Python runtime on demand before the @Context bean by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13203
* Python: resolve keyword-safe member aliases on Java objects returned at runtime by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13210
* Python: copy runtime annotations onto the generated Java class for reflection-based frameworks (JPA) by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13212
* Python: pass Java collections by reference and make introspected Python classes Serializable by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13213
* Python: dataclass stubs - inheritance, interface accessors, equality and generic attributes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13214
* Python: select functional interface overloads by lambda arity by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13226
* Python: Python classes as Class arguments, wrapper views in Python, numeric overload guard by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13233
* Python: implicit validation advice and self-invocations through the proxy by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13239
* JSON handling correctness fixes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13103
### Other Changes 💡
* Add a JMH benchmark for streaming a Flux of records by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13192
* Cache Jackson readers and writers per type by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13195
* Cache MediaType.isTextBased by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13194
* Remove netty server classes left behind by earlier rewrites, keeping the two micronaut-spring still needs by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13105
* Python: declare the compiler helper before the inner class loader type by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13247
* Python: bridge every public method of a generated class and copy @ExtendWith test annotations by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13228
* Python: compile imports across source roots and merge the package files of every root by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13229
* Python: extend Java classes from Python classes by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13242
* Python: shim packages import their subpackages on first access instead of eagerly by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13249
* Tokenize Accept-Encoding in place with scans bounded to the entry by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13193
* Let a buffer consumer receive the final bytes and the completion as one signal by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13190
* Write the trailing bytes of a streamed response as part of the terminating message by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13196
* Use the shared Python compiler Gradle plugin from micronaut-build by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13198
* Python: serve imported Java packages and annotations at run time without generated shim modules by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13250
* Propagate the exception of a reflectively dispatched executable method by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13132
* Python: gate the reflection data of generated classes behind micronaut.introspection.allow-reflection by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13252
* Close the undelivered copies when a combined add-and-complete fails by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13253
* Introspect Groovy records compiled from source through their record accessors by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13258
* Python: compiler baseline: an opt-in compilation profile, no trivial property hook overrides, mixed-package end-to-end test by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13251


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.2...v5.2.3
